task.task_name: Triage a personal auto collision claim
task.task_description: You handle new auto insurance claims. A policyholder reports a two-car collision at an intersection and sends in their account of what happened, vehicle details, damage photos, the other driver's contact and insurance information, and a police report number. Some details might be missing or conflicting, and there may not be a repair estimate yet. Your task is to check the claim against the policy and available records, see whether there's enough information to move it forward, flag missing documents or possible coverage issues, and send it to the right claims team. Straightforward claims can go through the usual process. Claims involving injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions need specialist attention. You're getting the claim ready for an adjuster, who will make the final coverage and liability decisions.

operational_subtasks.description: Review the policyholder’s collision account, vehicle and party details, damage photos, and submitted identifiers; compare the reported facts for missing or internally inconsistent information.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: this review occurs on every claim and involves one pass through the submitted materials; comparing a narrative with photos and party/vehicle details takes moderate effort, increasing when details conflict. No workload measurements were supplied.

operational_subtasks.description: Compare the loss date, insured, involved vehicle, and reported loss circumstances with available policy records to identify whether the policy appears applicable and any potential coverage questions.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: this check occurs on every claim and typically requires reviewing one policy record against the intake facts; effort rises when policy terms or insured/vehicle details need interpretation. No operational volumes or policy-system details were supplied.

operational_subtasks.description: Use the police report number and other available claim records to locate and review relevant incident information, comparing it with the policyholder’s account and submitted evidence.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: checking available records occurs on each claim, while locating or obtaining a police report is conditional and may not be possible at intake; when accessible, retrieval and comparison require additional effort. No report-access frequency was supplied.

operational_subtasks.description: Determine whether the available information is sufficient to move the claim to an adjuster, and identify specific missing documents or clarifications, such as a repair estimate when needed.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: this assessment occurs on every claim and usually involves a brief comparison of available information with what the adjuster needs; identifying and specifying gaps takes more effort when several items are missing. No missing-document frequency was supplied.

operational_subtasks.description: Evaluate the available information for reported injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions, and determine whether specialist attention is indicated rather than usual handling.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: the screening occurs on every claim; most checks are brief, with additional assessment when an injury, conflict, fraud indicator, or complex coverage issue appears. The frequency of such exceptions was not supplied.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Send claim handoff to the appropriate team
operational_subtasks.description: Transmit the claim to the usual claims team or indicated specialist team, communicating the incident summary, available records, potential coverage issues, information gaps, and any specialist indicators for the adjuster’s review.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: one handoff occurs per claim; preparing and routing a concise summary is usually straightforward, with modest additional effort to convey multiple gaps or specialist concerns. No system or coordination details were supplied.
